objective: Maximize equal-weight open-to-close return among the daily top one or two names, net of 20/40/60 bps round-trip costs.

training.target: within-date average percentile rank of open-to-close return, mapped to [-1,1]
training.model: median imputation with missing indicators, standard scaling, Ridge(alpha=1.0)
training.tie_break: descending model score then ascending code

features.h02_activity_friction: row mean of no_trade_rate_20, flat_oc_rate_20, zero_range_rate_20; all three required

H03.name: joint_overnight_day_tug_state

features.h03_posnight_negday_rate20: rolling 20 valid prior sessions of I(overnight>0 and day<0), min 8
features.h03_negpos_balance20: rolling 20 rate(overnight<0 and day>0) minus posnight-negday rate, min 8
features.h03_negpos_balance60: rolling 60 rate(overnight<0 and day>0) minus posnight-negday rate, min 20

leakage_guards: open-to-close outcome is shifted exactly one exchange session within code before constructing signs
overnight_last is already strictly prior in the frozen panel
rows with missing prior open-to-close or prior overnight are excluded from each rolling denominator
zero returns remain in the valid denominator but in neither directional numerator
source date of every included sign is strictly before target date

features.h04_positive_overnight_rate20: rolling 20 valid values of I(overnight_last>0), min 8
features.h04_positive_overnight_streak: consecutive strictly-prior positive overnight returns, capped at 10
features.h04_attention: positive overnight rate20 * clip(xrank_atr14_pct,0,1) * H02 activity friction

tdnet_blocks.scope: Only source-complete dates; control is refit on the identical complete-date rows.
tdnet_blocks.H06: marketwide TDnet distraction counts interacted with supportive/adverse own-stock disclosures
tdnet_blocks.H07: Friday/weekend/long-holiday source timing interacted with disclosure direction
tdnet_blocks.H08: same-bundle directional corroboration, conflict, and directional family count
tdnet_blocks.H09: point-in-time earnings-wave position relative to sizes of previously completed waves

decision_rule.research_support: candidate top2 net20 mean exceeds control, three of three named subperiod net20 means are positive, best20-removed net20 remains positive, and top10-profit-code cash test remains positive
decision_rule.confirmatory_support: family-wise one-sided 90% lower bound for top2 net20 uplift is nonnegative
decision_rule.notes: No block is promoted to production by this retrospective run. Sparse or truncated periods are explicitly reported rather than imputed.
